environment.sourceUnconfirmed: The download source could not be confirmed. The official Npcap download page will open instead.
environment.openFailed: The browser could not be opened. Go to npcap.com manually.
environment.afterOpen: After installing, select Check again. If Npcap is still not detected, restart WWlogs.

missing.title: Npcap is not installed
missing.body: WWlogs needs Npcap to capture game network data. Install the official version, then check again.

unavailable.title: Npcap could not be initialized
unavailable.body: Npcap components were found but cannot be used right now. Reinstall the official version, then check again. If the problem remains, restart WWlogs or your computer.

noInterfaces.title: No usable network interface
noInterfaces.body: Npcap is loaded but reported no network interfaces. Make sure a network adapter is enabled, then check again. If Npcap is restricted to administrators, open WWlogs as an administrator.

noIpv4.title: No eligible IPv4 address
noIpv4.body: Network interfaces were found, but none has an IPv4 address. Check your network connection, then check again.

checkFailed.title: Check failed
checkFailed.body: The check of Npcap and network interfaces did not finish. Check again. If the problem remains, restart WWlogs.

startHint: Start capture before you log in to the game. If the game is already logged in, combat data from that connection cannot be decoded.
missingInterface: The selected interface is unavailable. Choose another interface.
interfaceUnset: No network interface is selected. Choose one in Settings → General to start capturing.
interfaceUnavailable: The selected network interface is unavailable. Recheck it or choose another in Settings → General.
intactNote: No loss or context downgrade reported in this interval.
degradedNote: Events may be missing. Eligible DPS values are lower bounds.
unreliableNote: Boundaries or loss extent are uncertain. Unreliable DPS is withheld.
chartEmpty: Waiting for the first second of data
timelineUnavailable: This statistic has no data source yet
skillsUnavailable: No skill breakdown is available for this source.
noContribution: There is no damage to break down for this source.
unassignedSkillNote: Damage confirmed for this source whose protocol data carries no skill ID.
noSkillRows: This source has no skill damage to break down.
damageNote: Confirmed local team damage in this encounter
takenNote: Confirmed damage taken in this encounter
